args.query:
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT *
FROM measurements
WHERE reaction_ms < (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) + (3 * (SELECT (MAX(reaction_ms) - MIN(reaction_ms)) / 4 FROM measurements)) FROM measurements)
AND reaction_ms > (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) - (3 * (SELECT (MAX(reaction_ms) - MIN(reaction_ms)) / 4 FROM measurements));

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT *
FROM measurements
WHERE reaction_ms < (SELECT Q3 + 1.5 * (Q3 - Q1) FROM (SELECT
    percentile(reaction_ms, 25) AS Q1,
    percentile(reaction_ms, 75) AS Q3
FROM measurements))
AND reaction_ms > (SELECT Q1 - 1.5 * (Q3 - Q1) FROM (SELECT
    percentile(reaction_ms, 25) AS Q1,
    percentile(reaction_ms, 75) AS Q3
FROM measurements));
